about.title: About the factory
about.body:
The porcelain factory has a long history: we make dinner sets, tea pairs, cups, vases and souvenirs from high-quality porcelain. Every piece is hand-painted and quality-checked.

The app offers the full catalog: current prices, stock availability and quick ordering with delivery.
